edits.old: Then the move to SETTLEMENT_OFFERED_AT_COURT is answered to rwb-case when the approver decides
edits.new:
Then the move to SETTLEMENT_OFFERED_AT_COURT is answered to rwb-case when the approver decides

  Scenario: AC10 Status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given the case is in a state from which the requested status change is not allowed
    When the status change is requested
    Then the change is refused and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC11 Role without right A decides the proposal
    Given a role without right A decides the proposal
    When the decision is requested
    Then the request is refused at the edge before any service call
    Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC12 Boundary test reaches another schema
    Given the step runs under the service identity of rwb-litigation
    When a boundary test reaches a notice row, a recovery_case row, a task row, a rule_row or another service's schema
    Then the boundary test fails the build
    Then nothing is released

  Scenario: AC13 Ownership and boundary rules hold (BR1 to BR9)
    Given the step runs under the service identity of rwb-litigation
    When the step runs
    Then the evaluation, the reasons, the cost and effect and the decision record stay with this service
    Then no other service's table is read or written and no person data enters the decision record

  Scenario: AC14 Consumed contract does not answer (retry and timeout)
    Given a consumed contract does not answer inside 2 s
    When the step calls it
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and no move is answered
